description: Plan a read-only Claude or Codex workflow toolbox from ranked HeyClaude registry entries. Each entry includes an inline install block (install command, config snippet, download URL) and the recommended stack is summarized as a copy-pasteable installPlan, alongside trust and follow-up guidance.

category.description: Constrain recommendations to a single category (e.g. 'mcp', 'skills').

goal.description: Plain-language description of the workflow or goal to build a toolbox for.

limit.description: Maximum number of recommendations to include (1–10, default 6).

platform.description: Target platform or client for the toolbox (e.g. 'claude-desktop', 'cursor').

name: registry.plan
